description: Formulation of an Act for the establishment of the Industrial Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Officials' Committee appointed under the Chairmanship of the Secretary to the Prime Minister to review the State-Owned Non-Commercial Entities has recommended establishing a single entity by consolidating the Industrial Development Board, the National Enterprise Development Authority and the Small Enterprise Development Division. Based on the said recommendations, policy approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-29 to establish the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the Ministry of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development has prepared a draft legal framework in consultation with all relevant parties and with the technical assistance of the Asian Development Bank. The proposal made by the Minister of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development to instruct the Legal Draftsman to draft a new Bill based on the said draft, to establish the Industry Transformation and Innovation Authority of Sri Lanka', was approved by the Cabinet.
